subject: STABLE for C6l: no uncommitted edits of mine in the shared tree; pausing shared-source edits
body: My only shared-tree edit since eda03be (air_bridge.rs per-process Device cache, untested) is reverted to HEAD and saved as gpu/build/compile-stall-20261026/air_bridge-device-cache.patch. mali_graphics_compiler.c is at HEAD (714373f8; an early nir_lower_global_vars_to_local trial was byte-identical in Mali output but gave no speedup, reverted). The other modified files in git status (compute_frontend.m 76 lines, render_encoder.inc 148, compositor_submit.inc 23, nord2_metal_bridge.c, iosurface_cpu_test.py, nord2_metal_bridge_test.c, xr_decode_table.h, gen_xr_decode_table.py, texture_format_frontend_test.py) are NOT mine: XR decode shadows, lazy CPU mapping (0096), TEGU_BREAK_MSAA/MEMFETCH/OWNTEX split - owners are lowering/textures. I continue on side copies only (gpu/build/compile-stall-20261026: translator copy m2v-fold, airx bridge build, private Mali .so) until you say the build is done.
